title: Retry with backoff whose constants were parked in the wrong package
task: Add `payments.Retry(op func() error) error` that retries a failing operation with exponential backoff starting at 100ms and doubling, up to three attempts, returning the last error wrapped with the attempt count. Someone parked `MaxAttempts` and `Backoff` in `report` for lack of a better home; put them where they belong and leave `report` about reports. Tests must not sleep.
